Blocks.Section: Compliance Program Announcements & Release Notes
Blocks.Text: On this page, you will find links and information about each Compliance API program release.

Blocks.Section: Profile.location field sunset on /v2/me and /v2/people
Blocks.Text: The top-level location field (for example, "San Francisco Bay Area") is being removed from /v2/me and /v2/people responses. Partners currently relying on location may begin receiving an empty or null value and should migrate to the geoLocation field (for example, request projection=(geoLocation(geo~,autoGenerated))), which is already available on both endpoints. See the Profile API documentation for guidance on using geoLocation with the geo~ projection to retrieve the location display name.

Blocks.Section: MultiPhoto/Carousel content model rollout: nested media payload for multi-image posts
SectionPath: MultiPhoto/Carousel content model rollout: nested media payload for multi-image posts
Blocks.Text: As part of an upstream, platform-wide MultiPhoto content model migration (rollout window: ~early June 2026), the processedActivity payload for multi-image (MultiPhoto/Carousel) posts returned by the Compliance Events API now nests the media entities under media~ → multiPhotoEntities[] → actionableContent → content → value → com.linkedin.content.MediaContent → media~ → elements, replacing the previously flat media~ → elements layout. Single-image posts are unaffected and continue to use the flat layout. Because Compliance Events serves the decorated snapshot archived at ingestion time, events ingested before the rollout retain the earlier flat structure. See the Compliance Events API overview and the UGC Posts resource reference for sample payloads and parsing guidance.

Blocks.Section: Legacy geo location lookup endpoints deprecated
SectionPath: Legacy geo location lookup endpoints deprecated
Blocks.Text: GET_ALL support on the legacy geo lookup endpoints (region, state, country/region, and country/region group) is deprecated. Migrate to the adTargetingEntities endpoint, which provides the new targeting typeahead finder and URN-to-name resolver API. See the ads targeting migration guide for the full endpoint mapping. These legacy endpoints will be completely sunset by August 31, 2026.

Blocks.Section: Instant Repost support on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Instant Repost support on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn members can repost existing posts from other members or LinkedIn pages. To know more about reposts, refer this LinkedIn Help Article. Reposts made my regulated members are now processed and archived as part of the Compliance Events API. More details with sample request and responses are documented here.

Blocks.Section: Data restrictions on Compliance Snapshot APIs
SectionPath: Data restrictions on Compliance Snapshot APIs
Blocks.Text:
As part of our commitment to delivering the best possible experience to our members we continuously evaluate and refine our APIs. In this regard, we will be imposing data restrictions on the UgcPosts API, Social Actions API, and Profile API effective September 15th, 2023.
More details on specific restrictions are detailed here.

Blocks.Section: Multi Photo support in UGC Posts API
SectionPath: Multi Photo support in UGC Posts API
Blocks.Text: UGC Posts API now supports retrieval of image data for user generated post with multiple photos. More details with sample request and responses are documented here.

Blocks.Section: Message edits and deletes on Compliance Events
SectionPath: Message edits and deletes on Compliance Events
Blocks.Text: The Compliance Events API now surfaces events when a regulated member edits or deletes a sent message. The values of the method field of the compliance event would be UPDATE and DELETE accordingly. For information and sample compliance events, please refer here.

Blocks.Section: Support for Pages Messaging on Compliance Events
SectionPath: Support for Pages Messaging on Compliance Events
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn has a new feature that allows users to message LinkedIn Company Pages. Archiving messages sent and received between a regulated member and a LinkedIn Company page are now supported via the complianceEvents API. More more information and sample compliance events, please refer here.

Blocks.Text: Updated Compliance FAQ page with new set of frequently asked questions.

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Event on compliance events
Blocks.Text: The Compliance Events API now surfaces events detailing LinkedIn events created by a regulated users. This includes LinkedIn events created by a regulated user themselves and also LinkedIn events created by regulated users on behalf of an organization. For more information, please see here.

Blocks.Section: Profile Cover Story
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn allows members to add a short introductory video as their Cover Story in addition to their profile pictures. The Profile API now has an additional field profileVideoInfo to provide details regarding the member's cover story. For more information on the Profile Video fields, please see here.

Blocks.Section: Contextual decoration of entities shared on messages
SectionPath: Contextual decoration of entities shared on messages
Blocks.Text: Compliance Events API for messages would now surface additional information for certain LinkedIn entities (e.g. Audio and Video messages) shared via messages. For more information, please see here.

Blocks.Section: Organization Entity ACL API Migration
Blocks.Text: /organizationalEntityAcls API will be deprecated on November 30 2021. Please use Organization Access Control API '/organizationAcls' to fetch a member's or an organization's access control information.

Blocks.Section: Messaging Events Backfilled on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Messaging Events Backfilled on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text:
The Compliance Events API experienced an issue from March 08, 2021 to April 28, 2021. Due to this, Messaging events corresponding to messages sent without any text and only attachments were not captured.
LinkedIn has completed backfilling the missing Messaging events during the affected time. All missing events would have funnelled into each member's Compliance Events API feed during June 16, 2021 and June 17, 2021

Blocks.Section: Messaging Events Backfilled on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Messaging Events Backfilled on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: The capturedAt and processedAt timestamp will be the time of backfill, which would be during June 16, 2021 and June 17, 2021. The activity and processedActivity fields of the Messaging events will contain createdAt and deliveredAt that timestamp when the activity occurred, which will be between March 08,2021 to April 28, 2021.

Blocks.Section: Organization Search and Geo Typeahead API Migration
SectionPath: Organization Search and Geo Typeahead API Migration
Blocks.Text:
Organization Search API will be deprecated on August 31, 2021. Please use Company Search API to find organization entities.

GeoTypeahead API '/geoTypeahead?q=federated' will be deprecated on August 31, 2021. Please use GeoTypeahead API '/geoTypeahead?q=search' to find the best matching geo URNs.

Blocks.Section: Messaging Events Backfill on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Messaging Events Backfill on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: Due to the recent outage in Compliance Events API, LinkedIn will begin backfilling the missing Messaging events during that time starting April 2, 10:00am PST. This means all the missing events will slowly funnel into each member's Compliance Events API feed after April 2.

Blocks.Section: Messaging Events Backfill on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Messaging Events Backfill on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: The capturedAt and processedAt timestamp will be the present time, which will be on or after April 2. The activity and processedActivity fields of the Messaging events will contain createdAt and deliveredAt that timestamp when the activity occurred, which will be between March 17, 9:30am to March 19, 2:20pm PST.

Blocks.Section: Messaging Events Backfill on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Messaging Events Backfill on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: Due to this backfill, you may experience some duplicate Messaging events, specifically around the start and end time of the outage.

Blocks.Section: Message Events Outage on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Message Events Outage on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: The Compliance Events API experienced an outage from March 17, 9:30am to March 19, 2:20pm PST. Due to this outage, messaging activities that occurred during this time are not surfaced. New messaging activities are now surfacing as expected. We are investigating on possible remediation.

Blocks.Section: Duration Increase on Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Duration Increase on Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: The Compliance Events API now supports up to 30 days of past LinkedIn activities, up from the previously supported 15 days.

Blocks.Section: Providing Services
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn members can display services they provide for free on their profiles. The Compliance Events API now surfaces the Providing services activities for archiving.

Blocks.Section: Breaking API Change Policy Guideline
Blocks.Text: As our APIs evolve, LinkedIn will make reasonable efforts to notify you of breaking changes in advance with sufficient time to adapt to these changes. We may make changes without prior notice if the change is considered non-breaking, or if it is being made to address critical product, security or privacy bugs.

Blocks.Section: Breaking API Change Policy Guideline
Blocks.Text: Please review this guide carefully to understand what kind of changes we consider non-breaking, and ensure that your application can adapt automatically to any change we categorize as non-breaking.

Blocks.Section: Permission w_fullprofile Deprecation
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn will deprecate and remove the legacy w_fullprofile permission from all Compliance applications on March 6, 2020. This permission provides access to the Profile Edit API and was used to maintain backward compatibility during the V1 to V2 migration. Access to the Profile Edit API has been and will continue to be from w_compliance going forward. Requests to Profile Edit API will not be affected if the access token has w_compliance granted.

Blocks.Section: Permission w_fullprofile Deprecation

Can be one of the following: SUCCESS, FAILURE, or SUCCESSFUL_REPLAY.

Blocks.Section: Clarification on schoolName vs school fields in educations object
SectionPath: Clarification on schoolName vs school fields in educations object
Blocks.Text: On October 19, 2018, we informed of the upcoming changes to school and schoolName. Below are other clarifications to the changes:

Blocks.Section: Clarification on schoolName vs school fields in educations object
SectionPath: Clarification on schoolName vs school fields in educations object
Blocks.Text:
The school display name on a member profile will take schoolName field as the primary source of truth.
If the schoolName field is missing, it will fall back to the display name of the organizationUrn decoration in school field.
If the school field exists:

The school display name will hyperlink to the school standardized page referenced by the organizationUrn in the school field.
The logo image will be from the organizationUrn in the school field.


When there is a mismatch of display name between the schoolName and decoration of organizationUrn from the school field, it is intended. It is a LinkedIn product feature that allows a member to customize the display name on his or her profile.

Blocks.Section: New Content Type in UGCPost - Marketplace Platform Opportunity
SectionPath: New Content Type in UGCPost - Marketplace Platform Opportunity
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn is introducing a new content type post, Marketplace Platform Opportunity. A marketplace platform opportunity is defined as a request created by a member who needs some service or help. For example, a mentee looking for a mentor or a member looking for a plumber.

SectionPath: New Content Type in UGCPost - Marketplace Platform Opportunity
Blocks.Text:
GET

https://api.linkedin.com/v2/ugcPosts/{urn}?projection=(author,clientApplication,created,distribution,lastModified,lifecycleState,permalinkSuffix,ugcOrigin,visibility,specificContent(*(shareMediaCategory,shareFeatures,media(*(media~marketplacePlatformOpportunity(requester~(localizedFirstName,localizedLastName),opportunityType(skill~;localeLanguage=en_US;localeCountry=US),location(region~region:standardization,state~,place~)),thumbnails,description,landingPage,originalUrl,title,status)),primaryLandingPageUrl,shareCategorization(skills*),shareCommentary(attributes*(length,start,value(*(*~))),inferredLocale,text))))

Blocks.Section: Invitations HTTP Status Code Change
Blocks.Text: If there is an existing invitation and the user is trying to create another invitation to the same invitee, LinkedIn regards this as a resend use case. In this scenario, LinkedIn Invitations API currently returns 409.

Blocks.Section: Invitations HTTP Status Code Change
Blocks.Text: We are changing this to 202 to reflect that the request has been accepted for processing, but the processing has not been completed. The request might or might not eventually be acted upon, as it might be disallowed when processing actually takes place. This change will take place on April 2, 2019 and be fully in effect by April 22, 2019.

Blocks.Section: Changes to school Urn and schoolName Fields
SectionPath: Changes to school Urn and schoolName Fields
Blocks.Text: The earlier announced changes on Oct 19 2018 to the school and schoolName fields will now be implemented on May 1st, 2019. The schoolName field will be continue to be automatically populated until May 15, 2019, for cases where the school field is populated. This is to allow partners to test the changes to retrieve the school name by decorating the Organization URN. After May 15, 2019, schoolName will only be populated for cases where the school field is not present.

Blocks.Section: school and schoolName fields changes in educations object
SectionPath: school and schoolName fields changes in educations object
Blocks.Text: On May 1, 2019, the following changes will be made -

Blocks.Section: school and schoolName fields changes in educations object
SectionPath: school and schoolName fields changes in educations object
Blocks.Text:
The school field will change from a school URN ( urn:li:school:XXX ) to an organization URN ( urn:li:organization:XXX ). The school field can then be expanded using decoration to get the name of the school, and other information.

The schoolName field will no longer be populated by default within the educations object. It will only be present if the user chose to type in or overwrite a school name in the UI, that is not recognized as a school URN.

Blocks.Section: school and schoolName fields changes in educations object
SectionPath: school and schoolName fields changes in educations object
Blocks.Text: Note: The school field may not be present in all cases, for example, if the user chooses to manually enter the information through LinkedIn, instead of choosing from the drop-down list.

Blocks.Section: Upcoming Changes to Profile API
Blocks.Text: On October 31, 2018 , LinkedIn will be limiting profile fields of members other than the authenticated member. This means that:

Blocks.Section: Upcoming Changes to Profile API
Blocks.Text:
V2 Profile API (/v2/people) will only return id , firstName , lastName , localizedFirstName , localizedLastName , pictureInfo , profilePicture , vanityName , headline , localizedHeadline , and positions .
Decoration of person URN will only return the same above profile fields.

Blocks.Section: Upcoming Changes to Profile API
Blocks.Text: Personal Profile API (/v2/me) will remain the same.

Blocks.Section: Upcoming Changes to Profile API
Blocks.Text: Action Required: If you are making Profile API or decoration of person URN in other API requests involving other fields than the ones listed above, you will need to update your application to only specify these fields. If you specify more than what is allowed, you will receive a 403 HTTP code with an error code of not enough permissions to access field ___ for GET /people .

Blocks.Section: Release
Blocks.Text: ContentTopic on Compliance Events API - The API now shows information about the ContentTopic Urn that was either shared, liked or commented on from the "What people are talking about now" section on LinkedIn.com.

Blocks.Section: Release
Blocks.Text: Messaging Events on Compliance Events API - the API now shows both inbound and outbound messages for a regulated member. The messages include personal mailbox such as direct messages and InMails, Recruiter and Sales Navigator mailbox.

Blocks.Section: Upcoming
Blocks.Text:
OAuth 2.0 Redirects: https://developer.linkedin.com/blog/posts/2018/redirecting-oauth-uas - Beginning July 23, 2018, we will start performing OAuth 2.0 redirects for applications still using the legacy OAuth 2.0 flow to the new OAuth 2.0 flow. This change will happen gradually for select users and will affect all members by August 6, 2018. With this redirect, the member will experience a new UI flow and a slight delay in the authorization due to the redirects. If you haven't already, LinkedIn recommends all partners to migrate to the new OAuth 2.0 flow for a better member experience. We will eventually deprecate the legacy flow but the date is yet to be determined.

Decoration Changes to Activity URN in Compliance Events API- On October 20, 2018, we will be changing the activity URN decoration schema on Compliance Events API. Please update your application accordingly to handle the current and new activity schema*. The new schema is subject to change pending discovery of any issues before release.

Invitation Received Events on Compliance Events API - The API now shows both outbound and inbound invitation invites for a regulated member.
Endorsement, Recommendation Requests, Recommendations Received Events on Compliance Events API - The API will return activities for endorsements received, recommendation requests received, and recommendations received.

Blocks.Section: Upcoming

Messaging Events on Compliance Events API - The API now shows both inbound and outbound messages for a regulated member. The messages include personal mailbox such as direct messages and InMails, Recruiter and Sales Navigator mailbox. ETA - July 16, 2018.
Groups and Group Membership APIs -The APIs will allow you to retrieve groups, group memberships and their activities such as posts, comments and likes. ETA - July 23, 2018.
